'''Chapter 580''' is titled "The War's Conclusion".

==Cover Page==
[[Cover Page#Animal Theater|Animal Theater]]: [[Tashigi]] is teaching [[Koby]] about [[sword]]s while [[Helmeppo]] chases raccoons who are stealing their lunch.

==Short Summary==
[[Shanks]] arrives at [[Marineford]] and ends the [[Summit War of Marineford|war]]. [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] and [[Jinbe]] escape on [[Trafalgar D. Water Law|Law]]'s [[Polar Tang|submarine]], and [[Boa Hancock]] follows them on a [[Marine Ships#Battleship|Marine battleship]].

==Long Summary==
The [[Marines]] loudly exclaim the presence of the [[Red Hair Pirates]], as they wonder how [[Shanks]] was able to arrive at [[Marineford]] so quickly, having fought with [[Kaidou]] the day before. Shanks then calls out to [[Buggy]] to give [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] his [[Straw Hat#Gol D. Roger/Shanks/Monkey D. Luffy|straw hat]], and convincing him that he will give a [[treasure]] [[map]] to his former crewmate in return. Buggy quickly complies and heads toward [[Trafalgar D. Water Law|Trafalgar Law]]'s [[Polar Tang|submarine]] to give Law his straw hat. [[Lucky Roux]] then asks Shanks if he is sure he does not want to see Luffy again, since it's been ten years since they last met, while flashbacks of Shanks giving Luffy his straw hat are seen. Shanks answers he'd love to see Luffy again, but seeing him now would break their promise.

[[Sakazuki|Akainu]] curses Shanks before [[Kuzan|Aokiji]] attempts to [[Hie Hie no Mi|freeze]] the submarine over with '''Ice Age''' and [[Borsalino|Kizaru]] decides to [[Pika Pika no Mi|attack]] using '''Yasakani no Magatama'''. The submarine attempts to dive to escape the ice and light attacks. Kizaru then dissuades the other [[Admiral]]s to continue their attacks against the [[Heart Pirates]], Luffy, and [[Jinbe]] for the time being. Meanwhile, [[Boa Hancock]] [[Haki/Observation Haki|senses]] that they are still alive and forces orders for a [[Marine Ships#Battleship|Marine ship]] to chase the submarine, covering that "Straw Hat must be destroyed at all costs". Buggy yells at Shanks for lying about the treasure map, who replies that it was a spur of the moment. Buggy's followers comically admire his attitude towards Shanks, and swear loyalty to him once more. Buggy then thinks that if he stays with the Red Hair Pirates, he will be able to get off the island safely.

Shanks orders [[Polo Marco|Marco]] to withdraw in order to stop encouraging the battle. While this happens, [[Dracule Mihawk]] walks away, telling the Marines that he did not agree to fight against Shanks, but only against [[Edward Newgate|Whitebeard]]. Shanks then threatens the Marines that if there are any others who wish to fight, then he and his crew will take care of them. Upon asking [[Marshall D. Teach|Blackbeard]], the ex-Warlord quickly decides to postpone their battle, satisfied with getting what he wanted already, and shortly leaves.

Shanks tells the remaining [[Whitebeard Pirates]] and Marines to save face for him. The Whitebeard Pirates mourn over the losses of [[Portgas D. Ace|Ace]] and Whitebeard. The Marines, the [[Pacifista]]s and the [[Seven Warlords of the Sea]] stop in their tracks. Shanks then tells the Marines that the Whitebeard Pirates and their allies will do the mourning, as he does not want their deaths to be exploited to the [[Blue Planet|world]] due to the broadcast. [[Sengoku]] quietly decides to accept Shanks' determination, taking responsibility for the Marines' actions, which is followed by Shanks' apology. Sengoku orders his subordinates to take care of the wounded and proclaims the end of the "[[Summit War of Marineford]]", the greatest war since the [[Pirate#The Great Pirate Era|Great Pirate Era]].

==Quick References==
===Chapter Notes===
*[[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]]'s [[Straw Hat#Gol D. Roger/Shanks/Monkey D. Luffy|straw hat]] has been handed over to [[Trafalgar D. Water Law|Trafalgar Law]] by [[Shanks]] via [[Buggy]].
*The [[Heart Pirates]] evade the attacks from [[Borsalino|Kizaru]] and [[Kuzan|Aokiji]] and finally escape from [[Marineford]] carrying Luffy and [[Jinbe]]. They are then followed by [[Boa Hancock]] in a [[Marine Ships#Battleship|Marine battleship]].
*Shanks' more notable nameless [[Red Hair Pirates|crew members]] return in a manner that makes them stand out more as major crewmates. Previously, these crew mates went unnoticed as most of the crew were generic [[pirate]]s in [[Chapter 1]].
*The [[Blackbeard Pirates]] leave Marineford without suffering any consequences.
*The [[Summit War of Marineford]], the greatest war since the start of the [[Pirate#The Great Pirate Era|Great Pirate Era]], ends.
*This is the first chapter since [[Chapter 432]] that [[Marines|Marine]] characters appear on the cover outside of a [[Short-Term Focused Cover Page Serials|mini-story]]. However, this is the first time that marine characters were on the usual [[Cover Page#Animal Theater|Animal Theater]] covers.
*This is the last chapter of the [[Marineford Arc]].
